SELECT ( SELECT i.url
FROM root_image ri
JOIN image i ON i.id = ri.image_id
WHERE ri.root_id = #{storeId}
ORDER BY ri.created_at DESC, ri.image_id DESC
LIMIT 1 ) AS url

SELECT url
FROM image i
JOIN root_image ri ON ri.image_id=i.id
WHERE ri.root_id = #{userId}

SELECT i.id, i.url, i.created_at, i.updated_at
FROM image i
JOIN root_image ri ON ri.image_id = i.id
WHERE ri.root_id = #{reviewId}
ORDER BY i.created_at
